## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 24 авг. 2026 г. - 25 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _rudie.cant.fail_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 4/5: "Great app with a lot of good free features but a lot of things are behind a paywall"
            2. _SmartRater_, 25 сент. 2026 г., 5/5: "Tick tick is an amazing app that has helped me get organize all my tasks for school. While some features are locked behind a paywall there are still a plethora of free features that should be more than enough for you to be more successful. Highly recommend."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Реклама** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Реклама.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: реклама.
      Период отзывов: 17 авг. 2026 г. - 17 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи замечают давление рекламы. Это сигнал о friction в монетизации и возможном преимуществе для более чистого конкурента.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Albro17_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 5/5: "Incredibly helpful in the ongoing battle against procrastination. I use it every day to keep track of my working hours, and bring order to the chaos that is being self-employed. The app's interface is refreshingly clean, there's a myriad of useful features and no annoying ads anywhere (I'm using the free version). One of those rare examples where the developers seem to have prioritised functionality over monetisation. Wouldn't wanna spend a day without it."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 24 июн. 2026 г. - 27 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _@mzz..._, 24 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "Best app I have found for productivity. But there are some bugs/errors in the app, which even after giving feedback about it, won’t be solved. Some bugs have been here for more than 3 years!!! They also won’t do anything with your feature requests, so don't bother. Eventhough this is the best app I found, I can't recommend it to anyone because of the terrible support. I already raised every bug to the developers and they keep repeating the same message. 3 years later “we are still looking into it” Also is devolving for timetracking so don’t bother if you want to use it for that."
            2. _Graceful_yogi_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "I like the app but constantly running into bugs. Not stable. On iPad, it just closed on its own. One time it moved all my tasks into trash. Running into errors while creating new lists and support has given up too as to why."
<!--/ir-theme-->
